:::{#thm-np-complete-in-p}
#### One NP-hard problem in P puts all of NP in P

If any NP-hard problem (@def-np-complete) is in
[P](p-and-np.qmd#def-class-p), then every problem in NP is in P.

:::

::: {.proof}

Let $L'$ be NP-hard and in P, and let $L$ be any problem in NP.
Then $L \le_p L'$ by @def-np-complete,
so $L$ is in P by @thm-reduction-preserves-p.

:::
